entities.summary: Luis Enrique "Tite" Arroyo, was a Puerto Rican Major League Baseball pitcher from 1955 to 1963. Arroyo was the first Puerto Rican player to appear for the New York Yankees and was a key part of their pennant winning seasons in 1961 and 1962. In 1955, Arroyo and Vic Power became the first Puerto Ricans to be selected to MLB's All-Star Game.
